title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran's family enjoys a fun beach outing filled with sandcastles, lively games and a family meal. Later, Chozhan lovingly tends to a weary Nila upon returning home.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi grows weary of justifying herself to the family while Revathi encourages Malar to work. Meanwhile, Shruthi and Karthi bond as Suresh visits Mathi's college.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karthik lies to Priya about Kasthuri, while Aadhavan comforts Pooja. Meanwhile, Madhu reveals her marriage to Arjun, who explains their love to her shocked father.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu defends Sarasu and Kaveri against Rajeshwari and welcomes Kanmani's family. After Rajeshwari exits, Kanmani and Pavithra's baby shower begins with Kaveri's blessing.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Azhagappan sidelines Kandhasamy's guests for a VIP and arranges food, shocking Murugan. Meanwhile, Kandhasamy's family panics over Karthikeyan saving on Abhi's dress.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Muthuvel's family warmly welcomes Suganya and her newborn baby. Later, Gomathi admits that she took the cash, revealing the truth behind Sakthivel's accusation against Pandian.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Seeing Manoj worried about the showroom theft, Muthu assures him of finding the culprit. He then questions Santhosh and Jeeva to learn more about Manoj's employees.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya and Prabhakaran suspect Sathish in Vetri's case and search his room while Devi distracts him. They find the drugs used and tap his phone to track his calls.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: With the groom's family yet to arrive, Manjamalai's family anxiously awaits Senthamizh's return. Meanwhile, Azhagar and Poongodi rush to save her from Thennavan.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma urges Rishi to send Ayyappan abroad, while Paraman plots with Ilamathi to stop him. Following this, Ilamathi requests Viji to make Rishi collapse to prevent it.
